description_en: Adds a Resource Directory (RD) member account to a Bastionhost instance so that you can import and manage the cloud assets of the member account through Bastionhost
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost add-instance-rd-member --instance-id bastionhost-cn-7mz2ve7h00a --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --member-id 1857311509574932 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddInstanceRdMember

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。

parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The UID of the RD member account to add
